Title: ManageIQ (formerly known as CloudForms) is now available in preview

Body.Content:
ManageIQ, a Red Hat platform that allows cloud operators to manage their resources on Azure Stack Hub platforms, such as virtual machines, and track usage data, is now available in preview. It also enables Azure Stack Hub to be managed by Red Hat technical tooling. ManageIQ is a supported platform from IBM formerly known as CloudForms by Red Hat.  This partnership delivers key benefits, from co-support of hybrid cloud deployments to waves of upstream innovation for expanded Linux capabilities.

Learn more on ManageIQ Blog

Learn more on ManageIQ
